theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_mul_ginvLim (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (hqi : q * qi = 1) (n : ℕ) :
gLim K q qi n * ginvLim K q qi n = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.ginvLim_mul_gLim (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (hqi : q * qi = 1) (n : ℕ) :
ginvLim K q qi n * gLim K q qi n = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_far (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (m k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < m) :
gLim K q qi m * gLim K q qi k = gLim K q qi k * gLim K q qi m

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_braid (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (m : ℕ) :
gLim K q qi (m + 1) * gLim K q qi m * gLim K q qi (m + 1) = gLim K q qi m * gLim K q qi (m + 1) * gLim K q qi m

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_quadratic (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n : ℕ) :
gLim K q qi n * gLim K q qi n = (q - qi) • gLim K q qi n + (q * qi) • 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.ginvLim_eq (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n j : ℕ) (hnj : n < j) :
ginvLim K q qi n = (ofLimₐ K q qi j) (Hecke.σInv K q qi j ⟨n, hnj⟩)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_eq (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n j : ℕ) (hnj : n < j) :
gLim K q qi n = (ofLimₐ K q qi j) (Hecke.σ K q qi j ⟨n, hnj⟩)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.ginvLim_mem (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n : ℕ) :
ginvLim K q qi n ∈ H K q qi (n + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.gLim_mem (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n : ℕ) :
gLim K q qi n ∈ H K q qi (n + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeColimit.ofLimₐ_apply (K : Type u_1) [CommRing K] (q qi : K) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke K q qi n) :
